title: Handling of group specific session management congestion control

entities.name: Group specific session management congestion control
entities.description: Congestion control mechanism activated by the network when group congestion criteria are met. When active, it follows the APN based congestion control procedure.

entities.name: APN based congestion control
entities.description: Congestion control mechanism specified in clause 6.3.5 that is followed when group specific session management congestion control is active.

entities.name: Group congestion criteria
entities.description: One or more criteria specified in 3GPP TS 23.401 that trigger the activation of group specific session management congestion control.

relations.description: Group congestion criteria trigger the activation of group specific session management congestion control.
When group specific session management congestion control is active, it follows the APN based congestion control procedure.
